confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Recife and Brazilian price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain, since Boa Viagem beachfront rates vary widely by season and property. Cocktail and wine are anchored to the local beer relationship rather than direct price knowledge. The FX observation comes from a search result attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, not from a direct read of the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized northeastern Brazilian coastal cities with similar tourism profiles, such as Fortaleza and Salvador, converted at recent BRL/USD levels. Accommodation assumes a visitor base in the Boa Viagem beach area. July is treated as an ordinary-to-busy month, with Brazilian school-holiday demand but no off-season discount.
